caseName: Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railway Co. v. Murphy
caseNameFull: Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railway Company v. A. N. Murphy and T. O. Murphy, Partners doing business under the firm name and style of Murphy & Son
attorneys: Mr. A. T. Boys, with whom Messrs. W. R. Bleakmore, W. F. Dickinson, M. L. Bell, Thomas P. Littlepage, John Barry, and W. F. Collins were on the brief for plaintiff in error. Messrs. W. C. Stevens, A. J. Morris, and Riford Bond, for defendants in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of section 237 of the Judicial Code, .as amended by the act of September 6, *6431916, c. 448, sec. 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.

Mr. A. T. Boys, with whom Messrs. W. R. Bleakmore, W. F. Dickinson, M. L. Bell, Thomas P. Littlepage, John Barry, and W. F. Collins were on the brief for plaintiff in error. Messrs. W. C. Stevens, A. J. Morris, and Riford Bond, for defendants in error, submitted.
